This close walking view does not show the entire compound; native overview was separately reviewed. First capture owner audit passes with five neighbors preserved.

West-wall oblique shows articulated damage edges, glass backs, selected small pits, three visible wall characters and upper glazing. Wall lies in deep scene shade; geometry is legible but this is not photographic material realism.

Distant LOD retains the compound roof/setback silhouette among surrounding city and river; no duplicate replacement shell seen. City surroundings remain inferred generalized buildings, not individually completed photographic models.
After distant LOD, the full west-wall geometry and unobstructed third-person avatar return with the same framing; no overlapping simplified shell visible.
Far-away release view shows ordinary map buildings/roads and no Sihang precise object. This view verifies bounded visual state at the scripted release location, not neighborhood photorealism.

After scripted owner release, full west-wall replacement and avatar are visible again in the same close framing. The scripted camera state screenshot is a bounded rendering check; complete user-interface mode switching is not inferred from it.
After city-manifest reset the close west-wall replacement, visible avatar and neighboring scene return; no duplicated target shell or missing target observed in this bounded view.
